```sh
kafka topic delete-records
```

Delete records before a given offset, per partition

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../../global-options/).

## Defaults

Requires explicit per-partition offset boundaries; it removes records before those boundaries.

## Before you run

Deletes records before each supplied offset boundary; this is not an offset reset. Consumers cannot replay the removed records. Save/check the boundaries and data recovery plan first.

## Flags

| Flag                   | Description                                                                 |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--brokers <string>`   | comma-separated broker list, e.g. localhost:9092                            |
| `--from-file <string>` | path to a JSON file in the kafka-delete-records.sh --offset-json-file shape |
| `--yes`                | confirm the deletion without an interactive prompt                          |

## Examples

```sh
kafka topic delete-records --from-file offsets.json --brokers localhost:9092 --yes
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

With `--json`:

```json
{
  "results": [
    {
      "topic": "events",
      "ok": true
    }
  ]
}
```

Declared exit codes: `0`, `1`, `2`, `4`, `5`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
